title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 10/14 — "John Ferrier Talks with the Prophet"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 10. Three weeks after the promise at the gate, the Prophet comes up the shingly path to John Ferrier's door.

Brigham Young sits in the farm parlour with a brown-backed volume under his hand and the window sun across the table, and he says what the Council has decided: a Gentile is not to have the Flower of Utah. Ferrier's daughter is to choose, within a month, between the son of Elder Stangerson and the son of Elder Drebber -- both with houses full of wives already.

Ferrier has kept every rule of the Elect for twelve years. He keeps this one with a riding whip in his hand and a word he has never said to them before.

The Prophet stops on the threshold to tell him what that word costs.

That evening, by lamplight, Lucy Ferrier hears what her father has done, and the old man talks of the hunter on the roan and a fast horse; and after she has gone to bed he loads a shot-gun and lays it on the bed beside him.

Chapter III of Part Two of Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
